api.title: Daily Energy for Moj Elektro
api.description: Everything is fetched straight from the Moj Elektro API. Create the token at mojelektro.si under Moj profil > Kreiraj žeton (unlimited expiration). The meter ID is the EIMM number under Merilna mesta / merilne točke.

data_description.token: Stored in Home Assistant only; it never reaches the browser.
data_description.pin: If set, opening the manual meter reading and deleting readings ask for it. Leave empty for no PIN.

link.title: Daily Energy for Moj Elektro
link.description: Uses the meter ID and API token of your Moj Elektro integration. Its sensors are also logged, as a backup.

data_description.pin: If set, opening the manual meter reading and deleting readings ask for it. Leave empty for no PIN.
